# Original TECH-02A corpus

All files in this directory were authored for FabParts TECH-02A and are licensed
GPL-3.0-or-later under the repository LICENSE. They contain synthetic geometry and
an original two-page PDF; no manufacturer datasheet or third-party library is copied.
They are real, parseable source files, not pictures or viewer fallback data. The
application only sees them when explicitly associated in a disposable test catalogue.

Synthetic.kicad_sym: Simple, FourSides, Multi (two units, alternate representation),
and Inherited. Footprints: DIP8, SOIC8, QFP48 (48 pads), QFN32_EP (33 including thermal
pad), R0603 and Connector6. These geometries exercise rendering; they are not qualified
production footprints. Missing, corrupt and oversized variants are generated by tests.

The optional native-check corpus references the installed official KiCad Timer:NE555P
and Package_DIP:DIP-8_W7.62mm without copying or publishing those files.
